title: Ultimate Minecarts
description: Complete overhaul of Minecarts. Attach them with chain and use the Furnace Minecart for faster travel!
body: ### This Mod completely overhauls Minecarts, especially the Furnace Minecart. ![bar](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/bar.png?raw=true)    ![bar](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/bar.png?raw=true) # 🚂 FEATURES ### 🔗 Linking mechanic **- Use Iron or Copper Chains to attach minecarts together** **- Unlike other mods, you can use all chain variants, and copper chains loosen with oxidation.** **- Sneak & right-click each cart to link them. The order doesn't matter in most interaction.** **- Furnace minecarts will always lead the train so they cannot be attached in the middle or the back** ### ♨️ Minecart with Blast Furnace **- Replaces the vanilla item _Minecart with Furnace_** **- New model, and GUI bar to show its amount of fuel** **- The Furnace Minecart goes twice as fast as the other carts. Powered rails still apply to it** **- Use any sort of fuel to power it. Use a water bucket to turn it off instantly** **- Particle and Sound effects to each interaction enhance the experience :)** **- Vanilla name and recipe are obviously correctly updated** ### 💥 Collision **- Minecarts at high speed deal knockback and damage. Drive through annoying mobs!** **- They scale with the amount of carts attached. A 7-cart train will kill most enemies.** **- Armour, enchantment and potions reduce collision damage** **- Can be toggled off in the config** ![bar](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/bar.png?raw=true) ## ⚙️ CONFIGURATION **Fully server-side:** - Toggle Linking mechanic. - Toggle Collision Damage. - Choose Furnace Burning Time (default: 72000). - Choose Furnace Minecart Max Speed (default: 32 blocks per second). - Choose other Minecarts Max speed (default: 16 blocks per second). - Choose the Chain Resistance, the distance at which chains usually break (default: 4 blocks). - Choose the Chain Distance for each tier (default: 1.2 | 1.6 | 2 | 2.6 | 3.2 blocks). ![bar](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/bar.png?raw=true) ### ✨🌐 FULL LANGUAGE SUPPORT **This mod is now translated into all 142 Minecraft languages.** - Furnace Minecart will show the correct name in your language - "Death by Minecart" message has been translated ![bar](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/bar.png?raw=true) CHECK OUT MY OTHER MODS:   [![ULTIMATE HORSESHOES](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_horseshoes.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_horseshoes)     [![ULTIMATE KEY LOCK](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_key_lock.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_key_lock)  [![FROST LAVA WALKER](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/frost_lava_walker.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/frost_lava_walker)     [![ULTIMATE MAP ATLASES](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_map_atlases.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_map_atlases)   [![ULTIMATE BETTER BELLS](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_better_bells.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_better_bells)     [![ULTIMATE VILLAGER ARMOR](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_villager_armor.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_villager_armor)   [![ULTIMATE BATTLE MUSIC](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_battle_music.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_battle_music)     [![ULTIMATE LOCATION MUSIC](https://github.com/nanakytim/host_image/blob/Main/ultimate_location_music.png?raw=true)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ultimate_location_music)
